fixtures.description: ChatGPT ref 52, the data half: period tabs, channel select, reference date, benchmark checkbox and traffic slider (lane L5) drive three KPI tiles, the line chart with its comparison series, the channel bar and pie charts, the scatter chart and the detail table with a Repeat, a total row and the date in its caption.

computed.channelVisits: map(baseRows, r => {x: r.x, rate: r.rate, visits: channel == "organic" ? r.organic : channel == "paid" ? r.paid : channel == "direct" ? r.direct : r.organic + r.paid + r.direct})
computed.plotted: map(channelVisits, r => {x: r.x, visits: round(r.visits * scale / 100), comparison: round(r.visits * scale / 100 * 0.9), conversions: round(r.visits * scale / 100 * r.rate / 100), rate: r.rate})
computed.channelTotals: [{name: "Organic", visitors: round(sum(baseRows, r => r.organic) * scale / 100)}, {name: "Paid", visitors: round(sum(baseRows, r => r.paid) * scale / 100)}, {name: "Direct", visitors: round(sum(baseRows, r => r.direct) * scale / 100)}]
